name: find-rows
description: Finds the rows in a Google Sheets tab where a column matches a value, exactly or as a substring, ignoring case, and answers each with its row number and its cells keyed by the header row. The spreadsheet can be a URL copied from the browser or an id from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets; tab names come from google-sheets__list-tabs. The row numbers it answers are what google-sheets__update-range takes.

spreadsheet.description: The spreadsheet URL copied from the browser, or its ID from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets.

tab.description: The tab's name, from google-sheets__list-tabs. When omitted, uses the spreadsheet's first tab.

column.description: Header text from row 1, matched case-insensitively after trimming.

value.description: Value to find, compared case-insensitively after trimming.

contains.description: When true, match cells containing the value instead of requiring equality.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching rows to return.
